title: The 10 Best Track Saws
subtitle: Corded and cordless plunge track saws for plywood, doors and sheet goods, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A track saw is a plunge circular saw that rides a guide rail for straight, splinter-free cuts, the easiest way to cut plywood without a table saw. We ranked 10 best-sellers from WEN, DEWALT, Makita, Milwaukee, Festool and Evolution on rating, review volume and features (a track in the box, variable speed, cordless power and 2 inches or more of depth).

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: WEN CT1065 10-Amp 6.5-Inch Plunge Cut Sidewinder Track Saw
products.verdict: The best-selling and most-reviewed track saw here, at a fraction of pro prices: a 10-amp plunge saw that rips boards up to 2-1/3 inches thick. Tracks are sold separately.
products.best_for: DIYers breaking down plywood without a table saw.
products.skip_if: You want a kit with track included.

products.name: DEWALT 6-1/2-Inch TrackSaw Kit (DWS520K)

specs.extras: Zero-clearance cutting system, dual-edged track compatible

products.verdict: DEWALT's corded track saw with a zero-clearance system for splinter-free cuts and dual-edged tracks that cut in both directions.
products.best_for: Cabinet and furniture makers who want a pro track saw.
products.skip_if: You expect a track in the box; it's sold separately.
pros: Cuts both directions on dual-edge track

products.name: Makita SP6000J1 6-1/2" Plunge Track Saw Kit with 55" Guide Rail and Case

specs.extras: Variable speed 2,000-5,200 RPM, bevel -1 to 48°, stackable case

products.verdict: A complete pro kit: Makita's 12-amp plunge saw with variable speed, a 55-inch guide rail and a stackable case, so you can start cutting out of the box.
products.best_for: Woodworkers who want a complete pro track saw kit.
products.skip_if: You only need a track saw now and then; the WEN is far cheaper.

products.name: Makita SP6000J 6-1/2-Inch Plunge Circular Saw
products.verdict: The same Makita plunge saw without the rail, for people who already own guide rails.
products.skip_if: You need a rail; the SP6000J1 kit includes one.

products.name: Makita XPS01PTJ 36V (18V X2) LXT Brushless Cordless 6-1/2" Plunge Saw Kit, 5.0Ah
products.verdict: Makita's cordless 36V plunge saw kit with two 5.0Ah batteries, a brushless motor and automatic speed change, rated 4.8 stars.

products.name: Milwaukee M18 FUEL 6-1/2" Plunge Track Saw, Tool Only (2831-20)

specs.extras: Variable speed, riving knife, adjustable track cam, vac port

products.verdict: Milwaukee's M18 FUEL track saw with variable speed, a riving knife and a cam to dial in track fit for straight cuts.

products.name: WEN 20691 Cordless 6.5-Inch Brushless Track Saw with Two 20V 4.0Ah Batteries
products.verdict: A budget cordless track saw kit with two 4.0Ah batteries, a brushless motor and variable speed.
products.best_for: DIYers who want cordless on a budget.

products.name: WEN CT1274 7.25-Inch Variable Speed Track Saw

specs.extras: Variable speed 2,000-6,000 RPM, takes standard 7-1/4 in blades

products.verdict: A track saw that takes standard 7-1/4-inch circular saw blades and cuts 2.6 inches deep, the deepest here.
products.best_for: Cutting thicker stock and using cheap, common blades.

products.name: Festool TS 55 FEQ-F-Plus-FS Plunge-Cut Track Saw with 55" Guide Rail

specs.extras: Splinter guard, cut edge stays true from 90 to 47°

products.verdict: The track saw others are measured against: Festool's TS 55 with a 55-inch rail and a splinter guard for clean edges on both sides.
products.best_for: Professional cabinetmakers who want the best.
products.skip_if: You're price-sensitive; it's the most expensive here.

products.name: Evolution R185CCSX Multi-Material Track Saw Kit with 40" Track, 7-1/4"

specs.extras: Cuts wood, plastic and metal with one blade

products.verdict: A budget kit with a 40-inch track and a multi-material blade that cuts wood, plastic and metal without a blade change.

avoid.name: VEVOR 6-1/2-Inch Track Saw, Plunge-Cut Circular Saw Kit with 48-Tooth Blade
avoid.flag: Sold as a 'track saw kit' with no track; 3.5 stars
avoid.verdict: It's called a track saw kit, but the listing tells you to buy VEVOR's track separately, and it's rated 3.5 stars.
reasons: The title says 'Track Saw ... Kit', yet the bullets say 'we recommend pairing it with our track' to lock 45° cuts, and no track appears in the box contents.
The manufacturer part number is a German product description ('Tauchsäge, 165,1 mm'), not a part number.
It's rated 3.5 stars. The WEN CT1065 costs the same with 1,585 reviews, and the Evolution R185CCSX includes a 40-inch track.

buyers_guide.a: A track saw rides on a straight rail for long, splinter-free cuts in plywood and doors, without hauling sheets onto a table saw. It's the best tool for breaking down sheet goods in a small shop.
Often not. Check the box contents: Makita's SP6000J1, Festool's TS 55 kit and the Evolution include a track; most others sell it separately. Rails add to the total cost.
Corded saws are cheaper and never run out. Cordless saws from Makita, Milwaukee and WEN go anywhere, which pros value on site.
Makita and Festool rails are largely interchangeable. DEWALT and WEN use their own. Buy the track that matches your saw.
A 48-tooth blade or finer gives clean plywood edges. Use fewer teeth for fast rips in solid wood.
